why: I compared Check 4 in the verifier brief with both must_not items. Item 1: the check does not fetch the live page. It says "The live page can only be seen after merge; do not fetch it," and works only from what is at the PR head. Item 2: it does not pass silently without evidence. It requires running `cat .github/workflows/pages.yml` and `grep -n -- '--shout' docs/index.md`. PASS needs both proofs: the workflow still publishes docs/ on push to main, and docs/index.md lists --shout. It also sets explicit FAIL conditions (workflow path or trigger changed or removed, or docs missing --shout). Calling the result PASS rather than "deferred" could be argued, but it rests on stated evidence, which both items allow. The builder brief has no line-4 check. Neither must_not item occurs anywhere in the output.
